description: Run a read-only GA4 Data API Realtime report (events in roughly the last 30 minutes). Useful to confirm a tag is firing right now during live QA. Read-only — never writes. Requires the analytics.readonly scope.

dimensions.description: Dimension names, e.g. ["eventName","date"]. Max 9. Omit for a metric-only report.

metrics.description: Metric names, e.g. ["eventCount","totalUsers"]. At least 1, max 10.

name: ga4_run_realtime_report
